restrictions: Target sha256-r38-prefix-v1 exactly: SHA-256 steps 0..37 on every padded block, standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward, all eight digest words. Two distinct complete two-block messages with equal digests; every output is recomputed before return.

Construction: the two-block dense-part-variant attack of ePrint 2026/1120 with (A0,A1,A2) variants (256 A0 values, 768-value A2 list), row 16 by the table-free split search of Section 5, exact tests for rows 17..37. baseline_improved names the organizer reference and asserts no improvement over any submitted score.

heuristics.statement: Per group M0 is a full uniform 512-bit first block; conditional on CV1, Step-2 is bijective (cited Lemma 4) so (Y,Z0) uniform and W7 hits F7 at p2; conditional row-17 rate 2^-10 by H1-uniformity on the 10-bit E17 mask; reachable distribution measured by S4 (0.06627, bins uniform, 0 collisions).
heuristics.scope: Counter expectations, per-variant success, caps, N_G. Not output validity (every output verified).
heuristics.extrapolation: From measured chaining values to all groups; caps tolerate 6.25% above expectation.
heuristics.limitations: A premise; joint variant events are H5.

heuristics.statement: Variant- and chaining-value-averaged q3(v) = Pr[rows 16..37 hold | W7 in F7] >= q3_model = 2^-101.5.
heuristics.scope: Per-group success rate. Rests on H1 for second-block word distribution.
heuristics.extrapolation: Monte-Carlo bounds to the full variant set; half-bit margin below both bounds.

heuristics.statement: Obtaining the published 38-step characteristic cost at most A_C = 2^70 compressions (2^-27.2 of T; negligible at this total).
heuristics.extrapolation: Hardware-ceiling and measured-predecessor arguments restated from cited packages.

heuristics.statement: Step-1 solution cost at most A_S = 2^60.
heuristics.extrapolation: Published Step-1 figure with multi-million-fold margin, restated.
Bound above any plausible development compute.

heuristics.statement: E[N(N-1)] <= E[N] over successful variants of one group (delta = 1); per-group success >= E[N]/2.
heuristics.extrapolation: Measured-small pair budget; bound uses delta = 1 regardless.

heuristics.statement: For every (CV, A0, c9-class), the split search returns exactly the u with phi(u)+d in G (Theorem S).

Section 1 counted machine (256-bit primitives, clean-invariant 32-bit values): 1039 ops per L (packed start loads, size-branch, entry 23), 320 cheap + 600 pass per (u,A2) for all 3584 deterministically, caps as listed; T = 2^97.16742 units.

phi(u) = s0(u) - u has max fiber 14 over all 2^32 inputs (established by the accepted r38 lineage exhaustive preimage count, dependency); every class holds at most 32 x 14 = 448 solutions and the 448-halt never triggers.
heuristics.scope: Candidate bound 448 per class; validity envelope; union-bound B.
heuristics.extrapolation: None (cited exact result, used as premise).
heuristics.limitations: Rests on the cited lineage computation; output soundness does not depend on it (full recomputation before return, safe halt).
